title: Flimsy
text: Flimsy. Very cheaply made—handle is flimsy & overall very flimsy construction.

product_metadata.title: Mr Coffee Claredale Stainless Steel Whistling Tea Kettle, 2.2-Quart, Brushed Satin
features: Whistling teakettle alerts when water is boiling
Flip-up spout cover for safe and easy pouring with Bakelite stay cool handles and trigger for safety
Do Not overfill kettle. Fill no higher than just spout opening
Do Not allow stove flames to exceed tea kettle base
description: Prepare your favorite hot beverage with Mr. Coffee Claredale 2. 2 qt. Tea kettle. Its silver-colored brushed finish and contemporary shape look great on any stovetop. Made of stainless steel with stay cool Bakelite handles it is a great addition to any kitchen.
